geolocated.label: Geolocated ad
geolocated.help: A geolocated ad is tied to an address and a sharing radius: only people located within that area can see it. Ideal for items to pick up or a hand on site. Turn it off if your ad is for your whole network, wherever they are.

radius.help: People located beyond this radius will not see your ad.
